items.title: Scripture
items.body: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost. — Romans 15:13 (KJV)

items.title: Farmer's Almanac tip
items.body: The county extension office in Athens can help with soil tests, pasture questions and garden problems. Call Henderson County's AgriLife Extension office for local advice.

items.title: This Day in History
items.body: On October 13, 1845, voters of the Republic of Texas approved annexation to the United States by a vote of 4,245 to 257, and adopted the proposed state constitution by 4,174 to 312.

items.title: Joke of the day
items.body: It got so dry last summer that I saw two trees fighting over a dog.
